frozen_on: 2026-11-16 (second freeze; the first, of the same day, was withdrawn after its stage 1)
note: constants and rules of the counted runs (stages 1-4); paper names: beta_j is the code's kappa, kappa = 1 / tau

filter.cost_units: each joint velocity as a fraction of its limit
filter.desired_base_input: the base velocity under the policy's commands alone

planner.layers: base (its height band) and rigid column and shoulder
planner.path: planned once on the full-pass map with the clutter, never replanned

pruning.objects: Qwen3-14B labels the objects of each segment once (obstacle, passable, irrelevant); asked once per scene and map kind before the runs (model_decisions.jsonl), shared by every method
pruning.allowed_contacts: from the plan: the gripper (fingers, hand, wrist flange) may touch the plan's task objects and the support of the picked object during manipulation; every other pair keeps its row

scoring: collision = simulator contact between the robot and an object on a pair that is not exempt; contacts on exempt pairs (dropped pairs; gripper with a task object the map has no node for) are logged and not counted
deviations_from_EVAL_SPEC: 6 instructions x 4 kitchens = 24 scenes, 168 runs (spec: 5 x 4)
pick-and-place instructions: sink to counter, counter to cabinet, counter to stove (screening tie 3/6 each; Kasra chose)
horizon 1800 ticks (spec: 1200, longer to be proposed)
path planned on the map with the clutter (decision of 2026-11-13)
close-fridge and stove scenes: as many counter objects as fit
stages run through unless results need a decision (Kasra, 2026-11-16)

first freeze withdrawn after stage 1 on open_drawer_s3 (now marked used_for_tuning): the model's choice of the objects the gripper may touch was replaced by the plan's task objects, the manipulation region grew from 1.0 to 1.5 m, and a stored-label lookup was fixed; every counted run was made after the second freeze
asking Qwen for the pairs is reported separately (qwen_object_choice.jsonl) and is not part of Table II
instruction_rule: in Table II if the unfiltered policy succeeds in at least 3 of 6 screening scenes; at most 6, by screening successes, ties: first set first, then candidate order
